name: creative
description: Loop's creative work on product imagery, packaging and CMF files, paired with the Vesper connector. The mother finds the product and the job and names who decides; genai-prompting writes prompts the way Loop's graded rounds taught; the Eclipse, packaging and CMF review skills grade against the real product; the feedback skill files a colleague's remark as an issue. Vesper holds the keys: it draws, grades three times, records verdicts and files feedback.
